CustomField.description: The Custom Notification Type (API name) of the site visit reminders sent to the channel partner agent: on the visit day, and the day after a visit that is not updated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Custom Notification Type API name, for example CP_Site_Visit_Reminder. Blank: no Salesforce notifications (the portal still shows the reminders).
CustomField.label: Visit Reminder Notification
